# C.D. Howe Institute

> Canada's leading independent economic policy think tank, producing research and convening expert discussions on fiscal policy, energy, housing, immigration, international trade, and financial regulation.

The C.D. Howe Institute hosts roundtables, webcasts, and policy conferences featuring government officials, industry leaders, and academics from institutions like Harvard University and University of Toronto. Events focus on Canadian economic challenges with significant activity in Toronto, Calgary, and Alberta, addressing issues from pension innovation to Canada-EU relations and national security.

## Key Topics

- Fiscal Policy
- Housing Affordability
- Energy Sector Policy
- Immigration Policy
- Canada-EU Relations
- International Trade
- Retirement Saving & Pensions
- Finance Canada
- Deputy Minister Speeches
- Alberta Economic Policy
- National Security
- Climate & Green Infrastructure
- Banking Regulation
- Development Charges
- Canada-Ukraine Relations

## Fiscal Policy & Federal Budget

- [Austerity And The Economy: Spending Cuts Versus Tax Increases](https://cdhowe.org/events/austerity-and-economy-spending-cuts-versus-tax-increases): Jack Mintz Lecture with Harvard's Alberto Alesina on fiscal policy
- [Inside Access: A Shadow Federal budget For 2017](https://cdhowe.org/events/inside-access-shadow-federal-budget-2017): CEO Bill Robson presents C.D. Howe's shadow federal budget 2017
- [Michael Horgan, Deputy Minister, Finance Canada](https://cdhowe.org/events/michael-horgan-deputy-minister-finance-canada-36): Deputy Minister Horgan discusses 2012 federal budget priorities
- [Fiscal And Economic Policy Priorities For The Province Of Alberta](https://cdhowe.org/events/fiscal-and-economic-policy-priorities-province-alberta): Calgary roundtable on Alberta fiscal and economic policy priorities
- [Ray Gilmour, Deputy Minister, Alberta Treasury Board And Finance](https://cdhowe.org/events/ray-gilmour-deputy-minister-alberta-treasury-board-and-finance-5): Calgary roundtable on Alberta's 2013 budget and flooding impacts

## Housing & Urban Development

- [Achieving Stability And Growth In The Canadian Housing Market](https://cdhowe.org/events/achieving-stability-and-growth-canadian-housing-market): Policy conference on housing affordability and mortgage regulations
- [Inside Access: Hosing Homebuyers – Why Cities Should Not Pay For Water & Wastewater Infrastructure With Development Charges](https://cdhowe.org/events/inside-access-hosing-homebuyers-why-cities-should-not-pay-water-wastewater-infrastructure): Members call with Daniel Schwanen on development charges impact
- [Build Back Better? – Cities In A Post-pandemic World](https://cdhowe.org/events/build-back-better-cities-post-pandemic-world): Webinar with Calgary Mayor Naheed Nenshi on post-pandemic cities

## Energy & Infrastructure

- [Energy Policy Council](https://cdhowe.org/council/energy-policy-council): Advisory council for C.D. Howe's Energy Policy Program
- [Steve Laut, President, Canadian Natural Resources](https://cdhowe.org/events/steve-laut-president-canadian-natural-resources): Calgary event with Steve Laut on oil & gas industry realities
- [Inside Access: Selling City-owned Electricity Distributors To Finance Infrastructure](https://cdhowe.org/events/inside-access-selling-city-owned-electricity-distributors-finance-infrastructure): Conference call with Harvard's Steven Robins on electricity privatization
- [Going Green And Climate Resilient: Advancing Canada's Economic Recovery](https://cdhowe.org/events/going-green-and-climate-resilient-advancing-canadas-economic-recovery): Webinar on green infrastructure and climate-resilient recovery

## Pensions & Financial Regulation

- [Pensions: What's Next For The Maple Revolutionaries?](https://cdhowe.org/events/pensions-whats-next-for-the-maple-revolutionaries): Jim Leech and Barbara Zvan on Ontario Teachers' pension innovation
- [Leo De Bever, Aimco.; Ron Mock, Otpp](https://cdhowe.org/events/leo-de-bever-aimco-ron-mock-otpp): Pension fund leaders discuss long-term value creation strategies
- [Canada's Domestic Stability Buffer: Swimming Against The Tide](https://cdhowe.org/events/canadas-domestic-stability-buffer-swimming-against-tide): Roundtable with OSFI's Jamey Hubbs on banking capital requirements

## International Relations & Trade

- [Eu Opportunities For Canada: Reflections On A Steadily Deepening Partnership](https://cdhowe.org/events/eu-opportunities-canada-reflections-steadily-deepening-partnership): Webcast with Ambassador Dr. Ailish Campbell on Canada-EU relations
- [From Crisis to Hope: Canada's Strategic Engagement with Ukraine in 2025](https://cdhowe.org/events/natalka-cmoc-ambassador-canada-ukraine-2): Webcast with Ambassador Natalka Cmoc on Canada-Ukraine relations

## Immigration & National Security

- [An Immigration System For Canada's Future: Perspectives On Where To Go From Here](https://cdhowe.org/events/immigration-system-canadas-future-perspectives-where-go-here): Roundtable on immigration policy with Baird, Hepburn & Thomson
- [Our Eyes Only: A Whole of Canada Approach to National Security Resiliency](https://cdhowe.org/events/our-eyes-only-whole-canada-approach-national-security-resiliency): CSIS's Nicole Giles on national security and policy partnerships

## Optional

- [Bequests](https://cdhowe.org/bequests): Planned giving and legacy donations information for supporters
